tagline: Share a local Postgres replica with remote agents without handing over the keys to prod.
requirements: Provide a working PostgreSQL connection URL. Use database credentials with read-only permissions. This is an archived reference server.

tools.name: query
tools.note: Runs SQL inside the reference server’s read-only transaction. Keep database credentials read-only as well.

seo.description: Set up the PostgreSQL MCP server with MCPWire. Share the query tool, use restricted database credentials, and connect a teammate’s MCP client.
